description: A Perl script for flashing firmware on Fritz!Box devices, involving network device discovery via UDP broadcast, FTP communication with ADAM2, and firmware upload procedures.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for interacting with ADAM2 devices, including environment variable retrieval, reboot, and check functions.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends USER command to FTP server.

methods.name: _PASV
methods.description: Sends PASV command to FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable from FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variable.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends REBOOT command to FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device via FTP command.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a flash check via FTP command.
